reason: The analyst's specification uses pre-treatment controls and leaves out the post-treatment mgmt_rating, as mine did. Its estimate of 0.50 (p=0.023) is close to my 0.58 (p=0.013), and I reproduced it with and without the 1% trim and with the full control set, so the 'positive effect' conclusion holds. The report is thin: it says nothing about unobserved confounding, and it applies an unexplained outcome trim. These are minor issues and don't change the result.
